name: Flip Tab Showcase
description: Full-screen split showcase with a heading and pill tab switcher on one side and a matching image on the other. Switching tabs fades text lines and slides the image while a pill glides to the active tab.
contents: Main heading and tab buttons with a sliding highlight pill
Image panel with one image per tab
behavior: Clicking a tab cross-fades text lines with a stagger and slides the image
Pill highlight animates to hovered, focused or active tab with a custom ease

props.name: heading
props.default: Explore the Layers of Handmade Ceramics

editableByProps: Number of tabs, all text, images, alt text and CTA link
Background, text and CTA colors through Tailwind classes
Base font size, image height, easing, durations and stagger

needsCodeEdit.change: Swap image panel to the left
needsCodeEdit.where: Order of the two w-full md:w-1/2 column divs inside the section

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the image slide direction or distance
needsCodeEdit.where: xPercent values in the switchTab timeline

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the pill and tab border tint
needsCodeEdit.where: border-white/[0.08] and bg-white/[0.06] classes on the nav and pill

fixed: Root is at least one screen tall and fills the width
Tab pill colors are white tints tuned for a dark background
